description: Prompts a MiniMax chat template WITHOUT a root branch renders (MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2.7 at revision d494266a4affc0d2995ba1fa35c8481cbd84294b: chat_template.jinja, the copy beside this file; its role mapping reads messages[0] only when it is a system message and its message loop has user/assistant/tool branches, so a root message handed to it as is would be dropped). The renderer hands such a template every root message as a system message and merges the system messages at the front, as it does for developer messages: `messages` is the request as a client sends it, `rendered_from` the list the renderer gives the template, `text` the reference implementation's rendering of that list (add_generation_prompt, string content as one-item text part lists; the plain-string rendering is identical); the text only, no ids: the slot is what these cases pin.

cases.name: system_then_user

messages.content: You are a terse assistant. Answer in one sentence.
Say hello in one short sentence, then stop.

rendered_from.content: You are a terse assistant. Answer in one sentence.
Say hello in one short sentence, then stop.

cases.name: root_then_user

messages.content: Top priority: always answer in French.
Say hello in one short sentence, then stop.

rendered_from.content: Top priority: always answer in French.
Say hello in one short sentence, then stop.
